title: Ashbury Rewards Award Chart Standard-Season Prices and the Protected Value of a Late-Cancelled Free Night Awards Stay
content:
The award chart's standard-season prices by category are those of the Ashbury Rewards award chart:

| Award category | Standard-season price (points) |
|---|---|
| 1 | 7500 |
| 2 | 12500 |
| 3 | 17500 |
| 4 | 25000 |
| 5 | 35000 |
| 6 | 45000 |
| 7 | 60000 |
| 8 | 85000 |

**Valuation clause.** The stay's protected value stated on the loss record of one of the Free Night Awards forfeited on a reservation cancelled after its deadline is the standard-season price of the award chart for the award category recorded on the cancelled reservation, in whole points. The stay's protected value is never below zero.

The award category is the Ashbury Rewards award category recorded on the cancelled reservation at booking, read from that reservation's record.

### Worked figure (hypothetical reservation)

A hypothetical Reward Night Rate reservation records award category 6 and is cancelled after its deadline. The award chart's standard-season price for category 6 is 45000 points, so the stay's protected value on the loss record of the award that paid its first night is 45000 points.

| Hypothetical category recorded on the cancelled reservation | Stay's protected value (points) |
|---|---|
| 2 | 12500 |
| 6 | 45000 |
| 8 | 85000 |
